message_session_access.name: message_session_access
message_session_access.using:
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_sessions s WHERE s.id = "agent_messages"."session_id"
        AND (s.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) OR (SELECT is_authorized_teacher(s.class_id))))

message_owner_insert.name: message_owner_insert
message_owner_insert.withCheck: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_sessions s WHERE s.id = "agent_messages"."session_id" AND s.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()))

class_enrolled_read.name: class_enrolled_read
class_enrolled_read.using: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM enrollments e WHERE e.class_id = "classes"."id" AND e.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()))

content_versions_teacher_read.name: content_versions_teacher_read
content_versions_teacher_read.using:
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM experiments x JOIN classes c ON c.course_id = x.course_id
        WHERE x.id = "content_versions"."experiment_id" AND (SELECT is_authorized_teacher(c.id)))

evaluation_session_access.name: evaluation_session_access
evaluation_session_access.using:
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM step_attempts a JOIN agent_sessions s ON s.id = a.session_id
        WHERE a.id = "evaluations"."attempt_id" AND (s.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) OR (SELECT is_authorized_teacher(s.class_id))))

step_enrolled_read.name: step_enrolled_read
step_enrolled_read.using:
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM experiments x JOIN classes c ON c.course_id = x.course_id
        JOIN enrollments e ON e.class_id = c.id
        WHERE x.id = "experiment_steps"."experiment_id" AND e.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()))

experiment_enrolled_read.name: experiment_enrolled_read
experiment_enrolled_read.using:
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM classes c JOIN enrollments e ON e.class_id = c.id
        WHERE c.course_id = "experiments"."course_id" AND e.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()))

profiles_teacher_read.name: profiles_teacher_read
profiles_teacher_read.using:
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM enrollments target JOIN enrollments viewer ON viewer.class_id = target.class_id
        WHERE target.user_id = "profiles"."id" AND viewer.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
          AND viewer.role IN ('teacher','content_admin'))

rubric_item_enrolled_read.name: rubric_item_enrolled_read
rubric_item_enrolled_read.using:
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rubrics r JOIN experiment_steps s ON s.id = r.step_id
        JOIN experiments x ON x.id = s.experiment_id JOIN classes c ON c.course_id = x.course_id
        WHERE r.id = "rubric_items"."rubric_id" AND (SELECT is_authorized_teacher(c.id)))

rubric_enrolled_read.name: rubric_enrolled_read
rubric_enrolled_read.using:
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM experiment_steps s JOIN experiments x ON x.id = s.experiment_id
        JOIN classes c ON c.course_id = x.course_id
        WHERE s.id = "rubrics"."step_id" AND (SELECT is_authorized_teacher(c.id)))

        AND s.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND s.agent_role = 'student')

student_experiment_profile_teacher_read.name: student_experiment_profile_teacher_read

        AND s.agent_role = 'student' AND (SELECT is_authorized_teacher(s.class_id)))

review_teacher_read.name: review_teacher_read
review_teacher_read.using:
"teacher_reviews"."teacher_id" = (SELECT auth.uid()) OR EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM evaluations v JOIN step_attempts a ON a.id = v.attempt_id
        JOIN agent_sessions s ON s.id = a.session_id
        WHERE v.id = "teacher_reviews"."evaluation_id" AND s.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()))

review_teacher_insert.name: review_teacher_insert
review_teacher_insert.withCheck:
"teacher_reviews"."teacher_id" = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND (
        "teacher_reviews"."evaluation_id" IS NULL OR EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM evaluations v JOIN step_attempts a ON a.id = v.attempt_id
          JOIN agent_sessions s ON s.id = a.session_id
          WHERE v.id = "teacher_reviews"."evaluation_id" AND (SELECT is_authorized_teacher(s.class_id))))
